note: Kentucky Lake fishing resort and marina near Springville, est. 1946, with cabins, a pool and a dock store. Its three campgrounds are mostly let by the season; the nightly sites are in the Resort Campground beside the pool, and the ones at its north end sit at the head of a cove. --Claude
summary: Buchanan Resort (pages behind Cloudflare, read headless): $45 nightly + $5/person, electricity billed separately, season Mar 20-Nov 1, nightly only in the Resort Campground (16 of 42 RV sites by the 2026 map; Big Eagle and Pine Point seasonal); LONG-STAY flag for the reviewer; lakefront kept on a few north-end sites; sewer and max_rig cleared; pin sits in the seasonal campground east of the cove.
flags: LONG STAY (reviewer): of three campgrounds, Pine Point is seasonal-only ('A favorite for long-term camping and mooring'; '$3,000 to $3,400 Seasonal Rates'), Big Eagle 'offers seasonal camping' (its Register link is a seasonal application; a $45 nightly rate is also printed), and the Resort Campground sells nightly 16 RV sites (26-33, 36-43) of its 42 on the 2026 map (26 seasonal, plus tent sites 34-35). Resort-wide the nightly share is well under half; within the Resort Campground ~38%. Not iffy: posted $45 rate, site map, Google 4.5 over 452 (whole resort); RV Life 4*/$$ on only 3 reviews. No discouraging wording toward nightly guests found. 'Electricity is not included in our campsite rates & will be paid by each renter' appears on the pages that print the nightly rate - unclear whether nightly guests are billed for power.

WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT on a few sites: the Resort Campground's north end meets the head of a Kentucky Lake cove. On Esri imagery the north-end pads (~36.41484,-88.10924 for the east column; ~36.41484,-88.10962 for the west) sit ~10-20 m from the cove edge over gravel and grass with no tree line; 3DEP gives 110.0-110.4 m against a 109.4 m (359 ft) summer pool, ~0.6-1 m above the water. On the 2026 map those are nightly sites 32-33 and 36-37 (34-35 are tent sites). Further south the east column runs beside a narrow, tree-lined inlet (view only). Per the few-clear-sites rule, lakefront with the caveat naming 32-33 and 36-37.

PIN 36.4148,-88.1082 sits in the campground on the peninsula east of the cove (likely Pine Point, seasonal-only), ~100 m from the nightly Resort Campground; suggested 36.41470,-88.10940 (under 250 m).

HOOKUPS: note-derived sewer: true cleared - only Pine Point (seasonal-only) lists sewer; the Resort Campground lists Water and a Dump Station. electric 50 from Big Eagle's 'Electric (50a)'; the Resort Campground page gives no amperage.
SITES: max_rig_ft 40 (note prose) cleared; no resort page states a length.
BOOKING platform phone: nightly sites through the Resort Office (731-642-2828); the online system is for seasonal reservations. Big Eagle's page also gives 731-642-3688 for check-in. PHONE unchanged.
